title: Service account created
description: A person created a service account for their own automation, and bound it roles that they hold (HUM-02, HUM-07, AUD-01). The service account acts with those of its roles that its responsible person still holds. It names the service account and the people by pseudonymous principal ID only, never by name or email address (NFR-20).

actor.description: The person who created the service account.

responsible_principal_id.description: The person responsible for the service account, who answers for what it does.

roles.description: The roles bound to the service account at its creation: sorted, each once.
